lines.text: On the day of Pentecost, they were all together in one place when a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven.
Tongues like flames of fire rested on each of them, and they were filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke in other tongues.
God-fearing Jews from every nation in Jerusalem gathered in bewilderment, each hearing his own prayer, and asked whether the speakers were all Galileans.
The crowd heard them in their own native languages declaring the wonders of David, from Parthians and Medes to Romans, Cretans and Arabs.
The crowd was astounded and perplexed and asked what it meant, but others mocked them and said they were drunk on new wine.
